name: Qvm_Load
note: Loads a COMPILED .qvm script binary from the virtual filesystem (appends/selects ".qvm"; big 0x130 stack frame builds the script object). Param: qvmPath = path like "LOCAL:common/ai/guard.qvm". RETURNS pointer to the loaded QVM object, 0 on failure (calls engine debug-state check 0x48F1D0 first). Use before executing/attaching scripts.
rationale: r2dec: ".qvm" string, fcn_0048F1D0 gate, object build; arg_130h

name: Qvm_Execute
note: EXECUTES a loaded QVM script program (the interpreter entry - despite the old analyst label QvmRead). On runtime failure reports "Error in QVM program: %s" / "An error occured in script file: %s". Param: qvm = pointer from Qvm_Load. RETURNS script result value.
rationale: r2dec strings "Error in QVM program: %s" + "An error occured in script file: %s"; reads qvm+0x8C

name: Qvm_Cleanup
note: Frees a loaded QVM script object: reads qvm+0x8C and releases the program block when non-zero. Param: qvm = pointer from Qvm_Load. Pair with Qvm_Load to avoid leaks.
rationale: r2dec: esi=[esp+8]; eax=[esi+0x8C]; conditional release

name: Qsc_Compile
note: Compiles a .qsc SCRIPT SOURCE into a .qvm binary: resolves the path (fcn_004B5B60), pulls the source through ResourceLoad (0x4B5F00), allocates a 0x94-byte compiler context via Mem_Alloc, emits ".qvm" output. Param: qscPath = script source path. RETURNS result object/flag.
rationale: r2dec: ".qvm" x3, calls 0x4B5B60 -> 0x4B5F00 -> Mem_Alloc(0x94,4)

name: QScript_Assemble
note: ASSEMBLER stage of the script pipeline: strips comments via regex "{.*:(.*//)*}.*", initialises the parser ("Initialising parser."), generates assembly code and WRITES IT TO "LOCAL:qvmbin.tmp" (also referenced as /0qvmbin.tmp). Params: srcText = script source buffer, srcLen2 = secondary length/context arg. Returns assembly result.
rationale: r2dec strings: regex literal, "Initialising parser.\n", LOCAL:qvmbin.tmp; args at +0x650/+0x658

name: QScript_ParseAndAssemble
note: PARSE+CODEGEN driver: logs "Parsing script and generating assembly code.", runs parser state globals (0xA442D0..), writes output ("Failed to open file '%s' for writing."). Params: srcText = script source, options = parser option word. Part of the QscCompile pipeline feeding QScript_Assemble.
rationale: r2dec strings both present; two args (+0x870,+0x88C)

name: ConfigCompile
signature: int ConfigCompile(int context, char* cfgName, int flags)
note: Compiles a CONFIG script: validates context, then loads its compiled QVM via QvmLoad (0x4B80B0); references the Task_New name during task-table wiring. Params: context = config context id, cfgName = config path/name, flags = compile flags. Use when (re)loading game configuration programmatically.
rationale: r2dec: "Task_New" string ref, call fcn_004B80B0 on [esp+0x18]; three stack args

name: Resource_Load
note: Loads a resource into memory WITH CACHE CHECK: first asks IsResourceLoaded (0x4B5B90); if cached returns the existing entry, otherwise loads and registers it. Params: resourcePath = virtual resource path, outBuffer = receives the data pointer. RETURNS resource entry pointer.
rationale: r2dec: immediate call fcn_004B5B90 then branch on result; two args

name: Resource_Unpack
signature: int Resource_Unpack(int* resPtr, int destAddr, int resSize)
note: Unpacks a loaded resource blob to a destination address. Params: resPtr = packed resource pointer, destAddr = destination memory address, resSize = bytes to unpack. RETURNS unpacked size/status.
rationale: r2dec three stack args +0x4/+0x10(+0xC dup); plain copy/decode body

name: Resource_PackUnpack
note: Opens a PACKED resource file via QFile_ReadWrite (0x4B1510, mode string at 0x53B604) and unpacks its contents through the pack table at 0x9436E8. Params: resFile = packed resource path, outBuffer = receives unpacked data. RETURNS entry/result pointer.
rationale: r2dec: call fcn_004B1510(edi, 0x53B604) then index table 0x9436E8

name: IsResourceLoaded
note: Checks whether a resource path is ALREADY LOADED in the resource manager (walks path handling backslash 0x5C segments against the registry). Params: resourcePath = virtual path, outEntry = receives matching entry. RETURNS non-zero + fills outEntry when found. Resource_Load calls this first - use it to avoid double-loading.
rationale: r2dec: backslash-compare loop (cl==0x5C), 6-arg helper 0x4B1020; args +0x118/+0x11C

name: Resource_Flush
note: Flushes/finalizes ONE resource entry: walks the global resource list (0x943E38), matches entry+0x34 against the argument, errors "Resource_Flush() : Couldn't locate resource at %p." when absent. Param: resEntry = resource pointer/address to flush.
rationale: r2dec error string inside function; compare [ecx+0x34]==edx

name: FileOpen
note: Low-level CRT-style file open used across the engine. Params: path = file path, mode = fopen-style mode string ("r","w","rb"...). RETURNS FILE* handle or 0. Prefer QFile_ReadWrite/QResource APIs unless you need raw stdio.
rationale: r2dec two stack args; thin wrapper family around CRT fopen

name: QFile_ReadWrite
note: VIRTUAL-filesystem open: parses the device prefix from vpath (errors "Illegal device name in path: \" and "Device not present: %s"), routes to the device handler chain (0x4B1620/0x4B1020/0x4B11A0) and returns a Q-file handle. Params: vpath = virtual path WITH device prefix (e.g. "LOCAL:...", "MENU:"), mode = access mode. RETURNS handle or 0. This is the correct opener for LOCAL:/MISSION: paths.
rationale: r2dec strings "Illegal device name in path: \" + "Device not present: %s"; handler chain calls

name: StatusMessage_ShowFull
signature: void StatusMessage_ShowFull(int timer, char* message, char* sprite, int styleByte)
note: Full-parameter status message: queues an on-screen HUD message with icon and styling (allocates via Mem_Alloc, reads current status word 0x540A8C). Params: timer = display duration, message = text, sprite = HUD sprite/icon ptr, styleByte = display style byte. Use MISC::STATUS_MESSAGE_SHOW wrapper for simple cases.
rationale: r2dec four stack args +0x14/+0x24/+0x30/+0x34; Mem_Alloc call; word 0x540A8C read

name: Symbol_Remove
note: Removes a symbol from the game-data symbol hash table; warns "Unable to remove symbol \"%s\" (not registered)" when absent. Params: symTable = symbol table, symName = symbol name string. RETURNS non-zero on success. Call after dynamically registered symbols are no longer needed.
rationale: r2dec error strings "Unable to remove symbol " + " (not registered)"

name: Symbol_CheckRegister
signature: void* Symbol_CheckRegister(int* symTable, char* symName, int extra)
note: Checks a symbol and registers it if new - ERRORS via ErrorShow("Symbol \"%s\" already registered in hash table") if the name ALREADY exists, so it doubles as duplicate protection. Params: symTable, symName, extra = registration payload/flags. RETURNS symbol entry or triggers the error dialog.
rationale: r2dec: "Symbol \" already registered in hash table" fed straight to ErrorShow 0x4AF7B0

name: TaskType_Set
note: Stores the TYPE ID onto a task definition structure (simple field write, verified 2-arg store). Params: taskDef = task definition object, taskTypeId = TASKTYPE_* enum value (TASKTYPE_GUN, TASKTYPE_BUILDING, etc. - full enum embedded in igi.exe .data).
rationale: r2dec: reads [esp+8] and [esp+4], stores; TASKTYPE_* enum strings in binary

name: Script_BufInit
signature: void ScriptBufInit(int* outBuf1, int buf2, int buf3, int bufSize)
note: Initialises the four header fields of a SCRIPT BUFFER structure (verified field-by-field stores: *out=buf2, then buf3, bufSize...). Params: outBuf1 = buffer struct to init, buf2/buf3 = buffer pointers/ids, bufSize = size field. Call before handing a buffer to the QVM assembler/parsers.
rationale: r2dec: sequential dword stores from all four stack args

name: GameDataSymbolRemoveThunk
note: Thin remover for the game-data symbol table: forwards its single argument down the removal chain (verified pure thunk returning eax). Param: symBuf = symbol/buffer to unregister. Prefer this over direct internal calls.
rationale: r2dec: mov eax,[esp+4]; ... return eax - pure pass-through thunk

name: SymbolRegister_Bool8
note: Registers a BOOL8-TYPED script variable slot in the game-data symbol table (2-arg typed thunk family; each sibling hardcodes its type size). Params: table = symbol table, name = variable name. RETURNS the registered symbol entry. Script code can then read/write it as a bool.
rationale: r2dec: identical 2-arg thunk bodies across the Bool8/Int16/Int32/Real32 siblings

name: SymbolRegister_Int16
note: Registers an INT16-typed script variable slot. Params: table, name. RETURNS symbol entry. Sibling of SymbolRegister_Bool8/Int32/Real32 - same thunk shape, different type tag.
rationale: same evidence pattern as Bool8 sibling

name: SymbolRegister_Int32
note: Registers an INT32-typed script variable slot. Params: table, name. RETURNS symbol entry. This is the common integer script-variable registration used by AI/game scripts.
rationale: same evidence pattern as Bool8 sibling

name: SymbolRegister_Real32
note: Registers a REAL32 (float)-typed script variable slot. Params: table, name. RETURNS symbol entry. Pairs with AIFunction_Set/GetScriptRealValue for float storage.
rationale: same evidence pattern as Bool8 sibling

name: LoadingScreen_Show
note: Shows the LOADING SCREEN: allocates a 0x1C-byte screen object, queries the active display mode (0x491CF0), and loads "LOCAL:menusystem/loadingscreen.res" with picture "LOCAL:menusystem/loading.pic" - or "loading_us.pic" for USA country builds. Param: picVariant = loading-screen type selector. Call before long loads so the player sees feedback.
rationale: r2dec strings loadingscreen.res + loading.pic/loading_us.pic; Display_GetActiveMode call; Mem_Alloc(0x1C,4)

name: Weapon_ConfigRead
note: Reads weapon configuration entries from parsed config text: repeated repne-scasb string scans + block copies populate weapon structures. Params: context = weapon system context, cfgText = config text buffer. Use within weapon definition parsing flows.
rationale: r2dec: repne scasb scan loops + es:edi block copies; args +0x14/+0x8

name: Config_ResetGraphicOptions
note: Resets graphic options to FACTORY DEFAULTS - machine-verified field writes: width=0x280 (640), height=0x1E0 (480), plus clearing adjacent flag bytes on the profile record. Takes no script args. Registered by igi.exe as "Config_ResetGraphicOptions" (site 0x40352B) and called by retail MAINMENU.QVM. Use to restore 640x480 defaults programmatically.
rationale: r2dec: *(rec+0x10)=0x1E0; *(rec+0xC)=0x280; flag byte clears

name: Log_Add
note: Appends a formatted line to the engine log (variadic printf-style, giant 0x400 format buffer at esp+0x404). Only logs when log-enabled globals 0xA43EC8/0xA43ED4 are set. Param: format = printf-style string + substitution args. Gate your spammy logs behind the enable flags.
rationale: r2dec: 0xA43EC8/0xA43ED4 enable checks; variadic buffer arg_404h
